q1.question: Are the results exact?
q1.answer: They are very accurate estimates based on standard financial formulas. Actual values may vary due to additional fees, rounding or specific contract conditions.

q2.question: Can I trust them to make decisions?
q2.answer: Yes, to have a solid basis for comparison. For important decisions, we also recommend consulting a financial professional.

q3.question: How to save a simulation?
q3.answer: Click the "Save" button next to the "Share" button. The simulation will be saved in your favorites, accessible from the menu.

q4.question: Can I share a simulation?
q4.answer: Yes! Click "Share" to copy the link. Whoever opens the link will see exactly the same simulation with the same values.
